displayName: Nextier Substage Sapphire Sept3 Labels V1
description: Row-level substage labels from the Sapphire layer -- one row per labeled telemetry sample. Mirrors nextier_substage_silver_aug27_labels_v1 so the substage dashboard can read either chain.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS sapphire_label_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id, fleet_name AS fleet_name, pad_name AS pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num AS api_num, record_ts AS record_ts, created_ts AS created_ts, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS sapphire_stage_uid, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS substage_label, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS label_kind, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS stage_closed, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_source, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS concentration_feature, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS conc_col, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS run_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0

sapphire_label_id.description: Synthetic label id: telemetry_point_id:algorithm_version. The primary key is this rather than telemetry_point_id because one telemetry sample can carry a label from more than one algorithm version -- keying on the sample would make the newer run silently delete the older one.

telemetry_point_id.description: Source telemetry row this label describes. Plain column, not the key, exactly as aug27 does it.

well_id.description: Well id from the source stream.

stage_num.description: Coarse titanium stage the sample falls in.

sapphire_stage_uid.description: Stage summary row this label came from.

label_kind.description: How the label was derived -- which landmark pair bounds it.

stage_closed.description: Always true for sapphire: it is post-stage by construction. Carried so the column means the same thing on both chains.

stage_source.description: Titanium split that supplied the coarse window.

conc_col.description: Concentration column actually used, or null.

run_id.description: Workflow run that wrote the row.
